sentences.text:
THIS CRL.P IS FILED U/S.438 OF CR.P.C PRAYING TO ENLARGE THE PETITIONER ON BAIL IN THE EVENT OF THEIR ARREST IN CR.NO.34/2023 OF BASAVANAGUDI WOMEN P.S.,
BANGALORE FOR THE OFFENCE P/U/S 498A, 313, 324 OF IPC AND SEC.3, 4 OF D.P ACT ON THE FILE OF THE 37th A.C.M.M.,
BANGALORE.
 THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
ORDER Heard Sri. Ashok Kumar M.C., learned counsel for the petitioners and Sri. Vinayaka V.S., learned High Court Government Pleader for the respondent-State.
Perused the records.

2. Present petition is filed under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. with the following prayer:
"Wherefore, it is prayed that this Hon'ble Court be pleased to allow the petition and thereby grant an anticipatory bail in Crime No.34/2023 with respondent Basavangudi Women's Police Station now registered as for the alleged offence punishable under Sec.498-A, 313, 324 of IPC r/w Sec.3 & 4 of D.P. Act which is pending before the 37th ACMM Bangalore.

Hence to release the petitioners who are the accused in the said case and grant such other appropriate reliefs, in the interest of justice and equity."
3.

In respect of Crime No.34/2023 of Basavanagudi Women Police, petitioners did obtained an order of anticipatory bail from LXXI Additional City Civil & Sessions Judge, Begaluru City (CCH-72)
in Crl. Misc. No.12159/2022 dated 17.12.2022 and the same is in operation and petitioners have also co- operated with the Investigating Agency.

entities.text: Additional City Civil & Sessions Judge, Begaluru City
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
4. However, at the time of filing of charge sheet, Investigating Agency have also invoked Section 313 of IPC as against the petitioners and therefore, petitioners have an apprehension that the petitioners may be re-arrested in respect of the same crime and approached the XLV Additional City Civil &
Sessions Judge, Bengaluru City (CCH-46) for grant of anticipatory bail in Crl. Misc. No.1372/2023,
which is rejected.

entities.text:
XLV Additional City Civil &
Sessions Judge, Bengaluru City
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Thereafter, the petitioners are before this Court.

5. It is settled principles of law and requires no emphasis that when once a person has been granted the bail, unless the same is cancelled by a process known to law, the said bail would remain in force in respect of a crime for which already the petitioners have been granted bail.
6. With this observation, this Court is of the considered opinion that no more further orders are necessary.
It is made clear to quell the apprehensions of the petitioners that the police cannot re-arrest the petitioners in respect of the Crime No.34/2023 only on the ground that Section 313 IPC be invoked.

7. Accordingly, this Court pass the following:
ORDER
The Criminal Petition stands disposed off.
